costs.intro: A BMW X6 M Competition engine rebuild starts from
costs.body: A BMW X6 M engine rebuild starts from £6,500, whether your car has the original S63, the S63TU, or the current S63. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
